UpdateStageName: Install native server module into persistent storage
UpdateSourceArgs: -c 'set -e; src=$(find "{{$FullBaseDir}}release-staging" -type f -name version.dll -print -quit); test -n "$src" || { echo "No precompiled version.dll found in release asset; server module unchanged" >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir -p "{{$FullBaseDir}}serverfiles/mod"; if test -f "{{$FullBaseDir}}serverfiles/mod/version.dll"; then cp -f "{{$FullBaseDir}}serverfiles/mod/version.dll" "{{$FullBaseDir}}serverfiles/mod/version.dll.previous"; fi; install -m 0644 "$src" "{{$FullBaseDir}}serverfiles/mod/version.dll"; echo "Moon Sweepers adapter DLL installed; restart AMP instance to apply"'
